recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-composition album cover featuring a full-body portrait of a male musician in a decorative suit on the left, contrasted against a textured off-white field with bold, multi-style typography on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between a blue-toned photographic panel and a warm-white text panel
Contrast between fluid, script lettering and rigid, blocky sans-serif type
Visual weight balance between the musician's guitar and the large-scale red text
coreInvariants: Split-screen layout with approximately 1/3 photo and 2/3 text field
High-contrast red and black typography against a light background
A musician in a highly decorative, embroidered western-style suit

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician positioned on the far left, occupying the full vertical height of the blue panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red name in the center-right serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the musician's face, moves right to the script title, drops down to the large red name, and ends at the tracklist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the typography on the right to emphasize the scale of the letters.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/cream background for the text panel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant blue for the photographic background and suit.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and blue elements against a low-saturation, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of upright script and condensed grotesque sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: High-contrast strokes with large, circular loops on ascenders and descenders.
Sans-serif: Ultra-condensed, heavy weight with flat terminals and tight apertures.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'F' features an exaggerated top loop that extends over subsequent letters.
Sans-serif 'W' and 'M' have vertical outer strokes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic script and industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Offset drop shadow on script text

preserve: The specific red drop shadow on the black script
The ultra-condensed nature of the red block text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the main name.
Captures the mid-century brush script aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. The left 30% is a solid blue panel featuring a full-body portrait of a smiling man in a blue western suit with floral embroidery, holding an acoustic guitar. The right 70% is a textured, off-white paper background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a black script title with a red offset drop shadow at the top right. Below it, place a large, two-line name in ultra-condensed bold red sans-serif. Add a small tracklist in a simple black sans-serif at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the red text significantly larger than the script text?
Does the script text have a visible red drop shadow?
Is the musician's suit clearly decorated with floral patterns?
Is the layout strictly divided vertically?

mustRedesign: Original artist name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'haloing' or printing artifacts to simulate vintage offset press.
Ensure the red shadow on the script is offset down and to the right.
Verify the guitar details look period-appropriate.
Confirm the red text is vertically centered in its field.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen layout [Ratio 1:2] + [Subject in Decorative Uniform] + [Script Title with Shadow] + [Ultra-Condensed Block Name] + [Muted Primary Palette]
